purpose: Stop camera and sample sessions when a submitted frame has no matching worker result for fifteen seconds; clear stale output and permit explicit restart.

contract.deadline: Each transferred frame owns a 15000ms result timer, independent of the five-second video progress clock and the startup deadline. No pending frame means no result deadline. Completion, failure or Stop releases the timer.
contract.ownership: Results must match both the active session and the pending frame sequence. Unsolicited, duplicate, obsolete-frame and obsolete-session results cannot clear the current deadline or update presentation. A new submission and an explicit restart each own a fresh deadline. No automatic restart or camera permission request.
contract.verification: Reproduce retained running presentation on the parent by withholding an actual worker result in both camera and sample modes. Use deterministic unit clocks for exact deadlines, cancellation and message races; retain real browser/WASM/model, input-progress, geometry, timing, preset and CSP controls. Fake media only; no physical phone or sensor-clock qualification.
contract.preservation: Preserve scientific JSON, frozen native binaries, all prior camera evidence, resolved Cargo.lock and release WASM. No Rust/native/core/GPU changes, compiler runs, sensor downloads or new SDK/model acquisition.

resources.strategy: Hard-link existing hash-identical vendor files into a fresh E: site. Reuse the release WASM, matching bindgen and installed browser/runtime; keep all previous evidence and failed reports.
resources.asset_download_scope: Zero covers local SDK/model acquisition. Post-publication HTTPS checks may stream up to 32MiB without persisting vendor payloads.

remaining_80_percent: Measured canonical calibration/timing and independent motion, full-room accuracy, qualifying Linux hardware and integrated acceptance remain open.
